rapport_notes: Professional and gracious in accepting the customer's decision to shop around, but passive — no attempt to save the sale or address the price concern.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: not covered — none of damage coverage, Meet Your Mover, On-Time Guarantee, or Save Your Ass were ever mentioned

top_strength: Efficiently priced an unusual round-trip, partial-item swap move (couch trade between two houses) without getting flustered by the two-location complexity.
coaching_note: No differentiators were covered anywhere in the call, and when the customer signaled a price objection ('gonna try to find a little bit better price'), the rep didn't attempt to address it or offer any alternative.
